summary.en: Conan uses his voice changing bow tie to impersonate Itakura and is able to learn of the location and time of their planned meeting. As Conan and Professor Agasa head to the disclosed location, a subway construction site in Tokyo, their car breaks down. Luckily they are able to hitch hike with a man and woman driving a BMW. Conan notices that the man is unfamiliar with the car due to the steering wheel being in the left side instead of the usual right side like most Japanese cars. This causes him to begin suspecting the man and women to be hiding something. While passing a police check point, they learn that the jewelry robbers had abandoned their car in that area and may be near by.
summary.zhHans: 柯南与黑衣组织的接触线继续推进，谈判、追踪和决死行动交替出现，具体案件边界待拆分。
